why: Both row-13 arms closed CLOSE, but each ran context-bounded (stratified 100k FIT rows) after the v2.6 full-context OOM, while the champion's TabPFN member uses all 559,708 rows. TabPFN's in-context performance scales with context size, so the observed 4.9-5.2e-3 standalone gaps are CONFOUNDED: checkpoint quality and context bound cannot be separated from these two runs alone. Two cheap controls resolve the confound; both are measurements, not candidate searches.

control_1.name: v3.5 champion checkpoint at the SAME 100k context bound
control_1.protocol: identical to the row-13 arms (route view, n_estimators=1, fit_with_cache, int8 KV cache, autocast, batch 1024, stratified 100k context from FIT, seed 1201); icl_bf16 IS available for this checkpoint and is used (it is part of the champion's own recipe)
control_1.purpose: if v3.5@100k lands near the v3/v2.6 numbers, the context bound explains the gap and the checkpoints are comparable; if it lands near the champion's full-context 0.961458, the checkpoints themselves are weaker
control_1.decision_rule: NONE - this is an interpretive control; it cannot promote or close anything by itself

control_2.name: TabPFN-3 at FULL context (559,708 rows)
control_2.protocol: identical to the row-13 arms except the context is the entire FIT population; batch 1024
control_2.purpose: the 100k bound was triggered by the v2.6 OOM in the cache build; v3 is a different architecture (212 MB checkpoint, no icl_bf16) and may or may not share that wall. If it fits, the full-context number is the fair comparison against the champion's full-context member (0.961458 fold-0 route).
control_2.decision_rule: NONE as a control; if it completes, its result is reported with the same frozen comparison metrics (standalone, port_delta_v7, CI) and the row-13 verdict for v3 is restated on the FULL-context evidence rather than the bounded one
control_2.oom_handling: an OOM is recorded as a resource fact (RESOURCE_BLOCKED for the full-context configuration) and the bounded result stands

non_goals: no candidate promotion from a control
